nodes.title: 儲存 controlnet 圖片 (Save controlnet images)

widgets_values:
調整在"QwenImageDiffsynthControlnet"中的"strength"數字，可以調整"controlnet"的強度。

Adjusting the "strength" number in "QwenImageDiffsynthControlnet" will adjust the strength of the "controlnet".

resolution的數字越大，controlnet的預處理圖片越大。

megapixels的數字越大，生成的圖片尺寸越大。

The larger the resolution number, the larger the preprocessed image of ControlNet.

The larger the megapixels number, the larger the generated image size.

可在"AIO Aux Preprocessor"中，選擇你要使用的Controlnet種類.

In "AIO Aux Preprocessor", you can select the ControlNet type you want to use.

下面為Controlnet官方教學網址.

Below is the official Control.net tutorial website.

https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1

guide_size建議在512~1024範圍之間，數字越大速度越慢。如果面部修復功能沒有生效時，需提高guide_size的數字。

steps:2~8，步數越多越面部修復越仔細，但速度會更慢。

調整"denoise"可以控制面部重繪的幅度。

調整bbox_threshold, bbox_dolation, sam_diation 的數值可以控制蒙版尺寸，建議0~50之間。

The guide size is recommended to be between 512 and 1024; the larger the number, the slower the speed.
If the facial repair function is ineffective, the guide_size number needs to be increased.

Steps: 2~8. The more steps, the more detailed the facial retouching, but the slower the process.

Adjusting "denoise" controls the extent of facial redrawing.

Adjusting the values ​​of bbox_threshold, bbox_dolation, and sam_diation can control the mask size; a range of 0 to 50 is recommended.

如果不使用人物lora或檢查站中內建的名人時，不要開啟"FaceDetailer"的功能，FaceDetailer會降低臉部的細節品質。

Do not enable the "FaceDetailer" feature if you are not using Lora or the built-in celebrity in the checkpoint, as FaceDetailer will reduce the detail quality of faces.

去雜訊強度低於0.65，時圖片將會模糊.
When the denoise value is below 0.65, the image will be blurry.

可選擇使用不同的檢查站，但是重新讀取檢查站速度將會非常慢。

You can choose to use different checkpoints, but reloading the checkpoints will be very slow.
